changes: New: CALL & RESPONSE, Nordl3's call and response phrase generator as a track machine for the audio tracks (SRC SETUP, like VECTOR).
One track plays call and response (C+R), or a call track and an answer track split them, each with its own sample.
PHRS lays out C|R, CRCR, CCCR (three calls and an answer) or CCRR; VAR varies the repeated calls, MUT the response.
31 answer strategies and 11 endings; writes real trigs with PTCH locks (VOL on accents). Needs the Modwerk base loaded over USB (beta).
Not yet tested on a unit or in the emulator.
